systems.country_label: système d'information sanitaire / sous-systèmes d'information sur la santé
systems.owner: Ministry of Health (SMSI named as beneficiary of a consultant)

note: General procurement notice of 24 November 2025 for the World Bank PT2S (IDA USD 85m, GFF USD 10m): lists sub-component 3.3 on strengthening the health information system, 1.3 on digital health services, IT equipment and a consultant for the SMSI on governance, digital infrastructure and interoperability of all health information sub-systems, but names and describes no system and states nothing delivered; community health worker kits are paper registers.
